Short the bar after the first red 1-minute bar, cover 20 minutes later, 5 bps slippage. The open problem: one or two continuation losers a day (||(\approx -3\%||)) erase eight to ten ||(+30||) bps winners. This dashboard traces every decision stage and tests exits and filters aimed at that tail. Targets: win rate ||(60||)–||(70\%||), profit factor ||(\ge 1.5||).
